concepts.name: The Quiet Arch
concepts.brief: Two opposed clean round-headed lapis arches, thin architectural rails and two pairs of narrow ivory veils. Remove all Corinthian capitals and botanical decoration. Sculptural modern neoclassicism: the tall uninterrupted dark opening and four exquisite ivory folds do all the work. Clean rounded corners, one fine gold inner seam, no rectilinear gilded border. Great negative space. Quiet but materially rich.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished standalone TAROT CARD BACK for OLIVIA ARCANA. Portrait 7:12 aspect, full card fills frame, flat frontal artwork, all four neat rounded corners visible. No perspective product mockup or outside drop shadow. Attached reference is ONLY the material/brand vocabulary: midnight lapis, warm ivory, restrained champagne gold, finely carved arch and veil. Design the new composition specified below; do not simply repeat the reference.

NEW DESIGN: Two opposed clean round-headed lapis arches, thin architectural rails and two pairs of narrow ivory veils. Remove all Corinthian capitals and botanical decoration. Sculptural modern neoclassicism: the tall uninterrupted dark opening and four exquisite ivory folds do all the work. Clean rounded corners, one fine gold inner seam, no rectilinear gilded border. Great negative space. Quiet but materially rich.

Art direction requirements: a carefully authored TWO-WAY ornamental composition, corresponding through a 180-degree turn, visual character of a card reverse rather than a narrative card face. A central quiet opening, exquisite intentional contours, flawless physical junctions. Maintain an obvious visual hierarchy and enough dark breathing room. Fine microscopic tooling supports the large composition; avoid random filler or overly dense ornament. Shallow expertly carved/inlaid relief, believable contact shadows, crisp fine detail and restrained even illumination. Rich mineral depth with quiet very fine grain, not patterned cracks or digital speckle. Palette midnight blue #071b2b, mineral blue #24455a, antique ivory #e9dfc8 and pale gold #b69a65, adjusted only as specified in the design. No text, no brand name, no numbered labels, no pasted monogram, no watermark, no stars/eyes/moons/crystals/figures/landscape, no glitter, no plastic, no generic baroque embellishment. The artwork must feel deliberate, elegant and well made.

concepts.name: The Ivory Portal
concepts.brief: Reverse the material hierarchy completely: a warm ivory porcelain card surface with carved ivory two-ended oval architecture, midnight LAPIS BLUE drapery folded back inside it, deep blue central opening and the finest old-gold inlay. A luminous pale collector's object, understated Wedgwood-like blue-and-ivory craftsmanship without copying any brand pattern. Restrained tiny olive relief only at the top and bottom. Elegant, bright, quietly sumptuous.

concepts.name: The Lapis Intaglio
concepts.brief: Nearly monochromatic midnight lapis: the entire portal and two-way flowing drapery CUT INTO blue stone in extraordinary shallow intaglio, no ivory curtains. A single hairline champagne-gold oval outlines the mysterious empty opening. Fine creases glint in slate blue. Very dark outer rails and deep shaded carved folds, subtle polished versus matte material contrast. Minimal gold, ultra fine engraving, luxurious controlled tonal detail.

concepts.name: The Gilded Veil
concepts.brief: Two exceptionally thin flowing curtains made of satin PALE GOLD leaf drape into a spare ink-blue two-ended portal. Ivory appears only as narrow architecture inlay at the edge of each arch. The gold silk is refined ancient metalwork with microscopically engraved fold lines, never yellow plastic or molten metal. Deep dark blue uninterrupted central field. Fine quiet ivory perimeter. Strong material drama from GOLD fabric against lapis while geometry remains precise and graphic.

concepts.name: The Floating Fold
concepts.brief: Remove all columns and arches. Two large opposing ivory silk ribbons FLOAT as shallow relief above flat lapis and turn into an elongated open oval, one continuous graceful serpentine gesture. Their finely carved long folds are the entire border ornament. The two ribbons exchange over and under once at the waist, a beautifully resolved woven junction, no lumpy knot. Two broad dark blue counterspaces remain. Tiny brushed gold edge catches only. An airy fluid modern identity translated into a reversible card back.

concepts.name: The Interlocked Arches
concepts.brief: Two slender oval lapis arch frames interlock vertically like exquisite carved architectural links. Each long frame contains ONE small ivory gathered veil, top of one and bottom of the other. The frames weave over-under at the centre; the overlap and spacing are geometrically clear. Spare, jewellike double portal. Polished smoky blue edges, tiny gold inset lines, deep ink-blue ground. No botanical ornament, no thick columns, no extra symbols. Sophisticated intersecting architecture, open negative space.

concepts.name: The Olive Threshold
concepts.brief: The portal becomes an elongated oval olive bough carved in blue lapis with fine ivory veins. Two slender pale-ivory veils are drawn aside only at top and bottom of that olive opening, opposed through a half-turn. 16-20 long lanceolate BLUE olive leaves grow in intentional swept clusters on the frame, four small pale-gold olives. The branches define the architecture, no separate Corinthian pillars. Mostly blue, a few luminous folded ivory accents, quiet empty centre. Botanical art built around an opening, not a wallpaper repeat.

concepts.name: The Openwork Screen
concepts.brief: A finely carved pierced LAPIS SCREEN defines the perimeter of the card, like stone lace, using overlapping slender oval arches and petal-shaped negative openings, orderly custom geometry. The centre is one long clean empty blue oval. Four narrow ivory veil folds gather at diagonal quarters of the oval and tuck behind the carved screen. Opposed balanced repeat, delicate precise openwork, blue-on-blue depth, tiny gold at only four joins. Not baroque scrolls; exact highly refined architectural ornament with a lucid hierarchy.

concepts.name: The Ribbed Vault
concepts.brief: Two opposed fans of very slender IVORY architectural ribs make the upper and lower heads of the portal, inspired by a folded shell and vaulted stone. Lapis-blue veils stream along the two sides, their fine folds merge naturally into the ribs. The central opening is a quiet tall oval. No foliage, no Corinthian columns. Spectacular precision of 9 to 13 tapered fine ribs at each end, separated by hairline midnight slots; tiny pale gold seam at the throat. An original architectural reverse with compelling rhythm.

concepts.name: The Silk Seal

concepts.name: The Pointed Threshold
concepts.brief: A tall restrained softly pointed arch at each end, opposed top and bottom, creating a slender double-pointed central opening. Ivory veils are taut graceful curves drawn toward the two lateral waist points. Smooth midnight lapis outer architecture is very thin and almost abstract, one fine pale-gold seam. NO cathedral imagery, religious objects, gothic ornament, spikes or tracery. A clean elegant lancet geometry married to extraordinarily finely carved ivory folds. More vertical and enigmatic than the round original.

concepts.name: The Engraved Veil
